title: The Pod That Thought It Was Clever
story: In the glass vaults beneath the Bellhouse Library, Pellmoreth the Doubling Sporepod floats and gloats: every time it is struck, each pod splits into 2, and 3 brand-new pods puff out of the cracks as well. Mr 6 faces 4 pods and knows that swinging first is a trap, so he counts ahead on his scratch paper before deciding.
question: If Mr 6 struck the pods 3 times in a row, how many pods would there be after the third strike?
praise: Doubling then adding three was the right pattern — it just needed to be repeated for all three strikes, not stopped early.
hint: Work one strike at a time: double the pods you have, then add the 3 that puff out, and write down the new total before the next strike.
victory: Mr 6 sheathed his sword, dropped his scratch paper, and simply opened the vault window — the pods drifted out into the rain and dissolved. 'Fifty-three of you,' he said, 'and not one of you saw that coming.'
imagePrompt: A glowing green sporepod hovering smugly in a cathedral-like glass vault lined with books, while a numeral-six knight in a blue cape lowers his sword and reaches for a window latch in cool blue light.
